spec-sheet.build.idle: Pick one color per role. Every pick is measured before it is allowed through.
spec-sheet.build.intro: Two accents per skin: one system, one expressive, never a third. Pick them here. The sheet refuses anything that fails AA and shows you the ratio.
spec-sheet.build.reason.demoted: marks-only where AA fails · enforced · --accent-expressive-text → ink
spec-sheet.build.reason.marks: marks need 3.0:1 against paper or ink
spec-sheet.build.reason.reset: the skin's own two accents are back
spec-sheet.build.reason.system: system accent is text · AA needs 4.5:1
spec-sheet.build.reason.systemLive: system accent live · focus rings and links follow it
spec-sheet.build.reason.textRights: text rights granted at 4.5:1 · --accent-expressive-text → the pick
spec-sheet.build.row.catalog: Storybook. Tokens, type and the shared parts each get a page.
spec-sheet.build.row.figma: TOKEN BRIDGE, a Figma plugin that reads and writes the same JSON through GitHub. Figma and code share one file.
spec-sheet.build.row.gate: Chromatic runs on every push and diffs the stories the change touched.
spec-sheet.build.row.programs: Each program is a code-split registry entry and a component. Adding one is cheap on purpose.
spec-sheet.build.row.tokens: Tokens Studio JSON in tokens/, built by Style Dictionary into CSS variables and TypeScript. One source, three outputs.
spec-sheet.foot: Values read live from computed styles · contrast recomputes on theme or skin flip · motion quoted from shell/Window.tsx
